TE:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ORIGINAL TRANSPARENT T-SHIRT ARTWORK, not a garment image. Create a large high-resolution print master ideally 2400 x 2400 pixels with genuine alpha transparency. Audience: adult antique and vintage treasure hunters. Warm dry humor, approachable adult apparel rather than children's cartoon.
Exact wording, preserving punctuation and reading order:
"DO YOU DELIVER?"
"I ASKED, AFTER PAYING."
Concept: an enthusiastic buyer commits to a bulky vintage find before asking about transport.
Visual family DLF-004 PLAYFUL LETTERING AND ILLUSTRATION INTERLOCK. Broad friendly rounded hand-lettered capitals and clean outlined objects form one coherent open silhouette. Three repeating muted inks: warm cream #EFE2C1 for type and highlights, brick orange #BD6A42 for an antique cabinet, soft teal #82ACA3 for a very small modern hatchback. Dark outline may be #263D3D. Designed on Pepper Comfort Colors 1717, but actual image background MUST be fully transparent, no fabric, no dark rectangle.
Top: DO YOU DELIVER? in an expressive two-line rounded heading, not a generic serif arch. Middle: clearly antique wooden sideboard/cabinet with curved crown, paneled doors and turned feet, large blank-free hanging tag reading exactly SOLD, beside a visibly undersized compact hatchback with OPEN REAR HATCH and readable small cargo opening. Cabinet is too bulky to fit through hatch; car beside it, not crushed underneath or loaded. Objects share a short baseline and matching substantial outline widths. Essential illustration prominent, roughly middle third of composition; classic details simple enough for printing. No faces, people, money, moving truck, brand logos or licensed objects.
Bottom: I ASKED, on a smaller line, AFTER PAYING. on a strong friendly line, so the timing reveal is emphasized without making the setup dwarf the image. Text and object contours nest naturally with purposeful optical gaps; no overlaps obscuring words, no near-touches. Footer not stretched tall. Repeated color accents integrate lettering and objects. No stars, flowers, extra words, frame, grunge or drop shadows. Compact width:height about 1.05:1, centered, all content within edges. Flat robust screenprint-like shapes, minimal surface marks, no dense hatching or photographic gradients. Desirable everyday adult graphic tee design.
NA:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one complete original TRANSPARENT T-shirt artwork master, not a shirt or mockup. Large high-resolution image ideally 2400 x 2400 pixels, truly transparent background.
Audience: adult antique/vintage treasure hunters, especially those finding a replacement object that evokes family memories. Concept: an ordinary sale price understates the buyer's private sentimental attachment, which the buyer jokingly conceals from seller.
Exact copy, all present and readable, no extra words:
"PRICE: $8"
"SENTIMENTAL VALUE:"
"PLEASE DON'T"
"TELL THE SELLER."
Visual family: DLF-006 FRAMED ILLUSTRATED ARTIFACT adapted as an old dealer's valuation card. Shorter compact portrait composition width:height approximately 0.85:1, NOT a long receipt. Narrow dark slate blue double-rule perimeter with simple clipped or rounded corners; subtle functional field dividers, not an ornate tarot card. Transparent interior cloth is the paper; DO NOT render a solid cream/beige rectangle. The frame, lettering, object and divisions must belong to one composed collectible graphic.
Top field: PRICE: $8 in a handsome classic serif with $8 modestly stronger. Middle: one large plain vintage ceramic mixing bowl, distinctive broad curved rim, subtle signs of use and two simple horizontal stripes only, no branded patterns. Blue engraved/storybook drawing with restrained warm rust/ochre accent. Clear silhouette, generous space around bowl, no people, kitchen vignette or extra props.
Below bowl: small but plainly legible field label SENTIMENTAL VALUE:; then the surprise in two generous readable serif lines PLEASE DON'T / TELL THE SELLER. The bottom wording is the emotional/comic emphasis, not tiny annotation. Maintain optical air around copy and bowl; no accidental near-touches. Avoid multiple font families or poster density. At 8-inch print width, all essential copy must remain readable.
Ink palette: dark slate #315467 principal type, rules and bowl drawing; restrained muted rust #AA5941 for the private-value reply and one bowl stripe; warm ochre at most a small accent. Designed for warm Ivory Comfort Colors 1717, but actual full background alpha transparent. No filled paper backing, drop shadows, faux printed dirt, stars, flowers, dates, logos, signatures or copied artwork. The material object and valuation format must be unmistakable. Adult, quietly witty, collected and wearable.
TB:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ORIGINAL TRANSPARENT T-SHIRT ARTWORK MASTER, no garment. High resolution ideally 2400 x 2400 pixels, real alpha-transparent background.
Audience: adult antique/vintage treasure hunters who commit to a bulky find before figuring out transport. Wry, calm confidence. Exact copy only:
"I'LL TAKE IT."
"HOW IS A"
"SEPARATE QUESTION."
Visual family DLF-002 QUIET VIGNETTE AND DRY CAPTION, adapted as ONE simple two-object relationship rather than a detailed scene. Small calm uppercase humanist sans-serif heading I'LL TAKE IT. above the image. Main image centered: one clearly antique tall wooden wardrobe with a gently curved crown, paneled doors and two simple turned feet; alongside it on the right, a small unbranded modern compact hatchback in three-quarter rear view with rear hatch visibly open. Wardrobe distinctly too tall and wide to fit the small cargo opening. Relative scale plausible but visibly mismatched. Both stand separately on one very short baseline; cabinet not on top of car, not crushing car. A simple blank hanging secondhand sale tag on wardrobe door. No people, hands, wheels on cabinet, delivery truck, background scenery or furniture clutter. A few bold contour lines establish antique detail and empty hatch. Keep the image substantial and instantly recognizable rather than a tiny icon. Treat pair as a single isolated vignette.
Bottom dry caption in TWO balanced short lines HOW IS A / SEPARATE QUESTION. Quiet conversational lettering, smaller than illustration, clean solid strokes with ample readable tracking, not tiny print; no giant punchline or decorative arch. Open breathing room between type and objects while keeping unit visually connected. Shallow rectangular overall silhouette width:height about 1.3:1, with no border or panel. Restrained adult apparel graphic, not poster. Do not reduce essential cabinet/car relation to generic icons.
Ink: warm cream #EFE2C8 principal lines and type with very restrained desaturated ochre #BD9A61 on wardrobe door panels. No solid background fills. Designed for washed Blue Jean Comfort Colors 1717. Most cabinet/car interior is transparent cloth negative space; clean robust line-art and sparse flat accent, no engravings, delicate hatching, gradients, distress, stars, doodles, flowers, logos or extra words. Give letters adequate weight at a visible print width about 8 inches. Make a desirable understated shirt with dry humor.
